notes.title: Patch Notes for Aug 20 2022
notes.notes:
[h1]StarMech Patch Notes v1.2.0 Early Access[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Controller Support:[/b] Support for the XBOX controller has been added to the game. We know this has been a much asked for feature.
[*] [b]Blasters:[/b] Blaster bolts now pierce enemies instead of hitting only one.
[*] [b]Pulse Wave Cannon:[/b] Pulse waves now pierce enemies instead of hitting only one.
[*] [b]Fuel:[/b] Increase the amount of fuel per from from 0.4% to 0.5%.
[/list]

[h2]Next On The Roadmap[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Non-Weapon Upgrades:[/b] The last two upgrade slots can feel wasted, so non-weapon upgrades will be added to enhance the abilities of your StarMech.
[*] [b]More balance changes:[/b] Continuing to adjust gameplay based on player feedback.
[/list]
